newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom says did not discuss Sprint with C&W.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom says did not discuss Sprint with C&W.

text.p: France Telecom SA said it did not have discussions with Cable & Wireless Plc about an increase of its stake in Sprint Corp, as reported by the Wall Street Journal on Wednesday.
"I deny that we had talks with Cable and Wireless about increasing our stake in Sprint. We are very happy with the 20 percent we own in Sprint with Deutsche Telekom," a company spokesman said.
The spokesman said that there had been discussions between France Telecom and Cable & Wireless. "Cable & Wireless has been around to see us, among many others, to talk about Global One."
Global One is an alliance between France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom and Sprint.
"We are looking at improving access to the Asian markets for Global One, that can be through a partner, partners or otherwise," the France Telecom spokesman said.
